verdict.rationale: Adyen is a hosted payments platform, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. The evidence never states that the core product's source is published or names an open-source license. The only public repositories mentioned are the MCP server (github.com/Adyen/adyen-mcp) and the OpenAPI specification repo. Both are adjacent tooling and specs rather than product source, and neither has a stated license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
